title: Plaintext Stack::receive does not unwrap SRH-consumed IPv6-in-IPv6 tunnels (divergence from RPL mirror)
description: Edge-case review finding on cmwv (low severity, fail-safe): the new Stack::receive decap hook (stack.rs, after the SRH survey) only checks ipv6[6] == IPV6_IN_IPV6, so a source-routed outer whose SRH has been fully consumed still carries next-header ROUTING at byte 6 and is delivered to upper layers still-encapsulated (opaque, undeliverable) instead of being strip-then-decapsulated like the RPL owner path (receive.rs:349-356 process_source_route). No unauthorized inner delivery occurs. Options per reviewer: (a) strip the consumed SRH then decap, mirroring process_source_route, or (b) document/test that source-routed tunnels are out of scope for the plaintext profile. Decide per the plaintext stack's actual deployment contract.
